Designated at-grade crossings (El Camino Real light between Enrique Dr & Botello Ave; Rainey Trail between Lynnhaven Ln & Miona Shores Dr; Fruitland Park CR 466A/CR 468 points; US 27/441 at SE 176th St) are not modelled unless OSM has a cart path there — routes may detour to tunnels.
Fruitland Park allows carts on CR 25A (Dixie Ave) south of Shiloh St and several Lake County roads; banned here only north of Shiloh is not split — whole CR 25A blocked (conservative).
Night driving with lights (F.S. 316.212(6)) not modelled; LSVs allowed on multi-modal paths per Max.
